requires: Midnight Enchanting catch-up: character is behind the knowledge cap and has completed the weekly Enchanting trainer quest, earned 5 Swirling Arcane Essence and 1 Brimming Mana Shard through disenchanting, and obtained both weekly zone-treasure drops (Lost Thalassian Vellum and Voidstorm Ashes). Eligibility by item level and armor versus weapon is not established by this guide.
quote: Once those are done, Glimmering Powder will begin to drop
notes: Nontradeable one-point knowledge catch-up, not a material for expected-gold valuation. Output item ID 267653 independently cross-identified against https://www.wowhead.com/item=267653/glimmering-powder; no verified lower item-level requirement. This requirement is author guide-reported, not independently tested in-game.
